arguments.rationale: The agent's changes to OneToOne's __init__ and update methods introduced a bug that caused the hidden test_one_to_one test to fail (the test expects correct handling of non-unique one-to-one inputs per R1), and the __rsub__ implementation on _ComplementSet also failed the test_complement_set hidden test (R4), indicating the agent's code changes were incorrect despite passing its own integration checks.
